--- name: adaptiveTutorialWelcomeSkill description: Greets the learner when a tutorial chat starts. ---
# Tutor Chat Welcome
Greets the learner when a tutorial chat starts.
## When to use
- First message of a tutorial channel.
## How it works
1. Stops if the channel already has non-system messages. 2. Finds the tutorial from `tutorialid`, or from the section's tutorial for a daily challenge. 3. Renders `chat_tutor_welcome`.
## Inputs
- `channel`: The tutorial chat channel (from the TutorMessageContext) - `tutorialid`: The tutorial to start - `isdailychallenge`: true when this is a daily challenge - `sectionid`: The section, for a daily challenge
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `tutorMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `tutorial`, `messagerendertype=welcome`, and the welcome response
## Implementation
- Bean `adaptiveTutorialWelcomeSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AdaptiveTutorialWelcomeSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: adaptiveTutorialContinueSkill description: Shows the learner the next piece of tutorial content: text, asset or multiple-choice question. ---
# Tutor Chat Continue
Shows the learner the next piece of tutorial content: text, asset or multiple-choice question.
## When to use
- Each time the tutorial should move forward.
## How it works
1. Finds the next section and component after `sectionid`/`componentid`, skipping questions already answered and limiting questions per section (`questions-per-section` setting). 2. Sets the render type to `question`, `asset` or `text` and fills in the question or asset details. 3. Keeps going until it reaches a question, asset or exercise that needs the learner. Ends the tutorial when nothing is left.
## Inputs
- `channel`: The tutorial chat channel (from the TutorMessageContext) - `tutorialid`: The tutorial being played - `sectionid`: The current section - `componentid`: The current component - `isdailychallenge`: true for a daily challenge - `siteroot`: Site root used to build asset URLs
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `tutorMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `sectionid`, `componentid`, `componentcontent`, `componenttype`, `contentrole`, `question` or `asset`, `messagerendertype`
## Implementation
- Bean `adaptiveTutorialContinueSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AdaptiveTutorialContinueSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: adaptiveTutorialAnswerSkill description: Grades a learner's answer to a multiple-choice question, gives feedback, and updates progress. ---
# Tutor Chat Answer
Grades a learner's answer to a multiple-choice question, gives feedback, and updates progress.
## When to use
- The learner submits an answer.
## How it works
1. Compares `selectedoption` with the question's correct option. 2. Awards points for the question's cognitive level, plus a bonus based on `confidence`. 3. Saves a `tutoranswer` record. 4. Writes feedback with the `chat_tutor_feedback` structure, then runs `chat_tutor_progress`.
## Inputs
- `channel`: The tutorial chat channel (from the TutorMessageContext) - `questionid`: The `entityquestion` being answered - `selectedoption`: The chosen option, e.g. option_b - `confidence`: The learner's confidence level - `tutorialid`: The tutorial
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `tutorMessageContext`
## Outputs
- A `tutoranswer` record, `iscorrect`, `question`, and feedback with `messagerendertype=answereval`
## Implementation
- Bean `adaptiveTutorialAnswerSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AdaptiveTutorialAnswerSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: adaptiveTutorialProgressSkill description: Recalculates the learner's beginner, competent and expert progress for a tutorial. ---
# Tutor Progress
Recalculates the learner's beginner, competent and expert progress for a tutorial.
## When to use
- After each graded answer.
## How it works
1. Loads every question in the tutorial and the learner's answers. 2. Adds up points plus bonus per cognitive level. Answers lose 1% per day since they were last scored. 3. Saves the averages to the `tutorialprogress` record.
## Inputs
- `channel`: The tutorial chat channel (from the TutorMessageContext) - `tutorialid`: The tutorial
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `tutorMessageContext`
## Outputs
- `beginnerprogress`, `competentprogress`, `expertprogress`, and `messagerendertype=progressupdate`
## Implementation
- Bean `adaptiveTutorialProgressSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AdaptiveTutorialProgressSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: adaptiveTutorialUserCommentSkill description: Answers a learner's free-text comment or question using the tutorial's embedded content. ---
# Tutor Chat User Comment
Answers a learner's free-text comment or question using the tutorial's embedded content.
## When to use
- The learner types a message instead of answering a question.
## How it works
1. Builds the relevant chat history for the current section. 2. Sends the message, history and the tutorial's document ids to the embedding server's `/chat`. 3. Replies with the answer.
## Inputs
- `channel`: The tutorial chat channel (from the TutorMessageContext) - `usermessage`: The learner's message - `tutorialid`: The tutorial - `sectionid`: The current section
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `tutorMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The answer, with `messagerendertype=agentcomment`
## Implementation
- Bean `adaptiveTutorialUserCommentSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AdaptiveTutorialUserCommentSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`

--- name: adaptiveTutorialEndSkill description: Ends a tutorial session and marks the channel finished. ---
# Tutor Chat End
Ends a tutorial session and marks the channel finished.
## When to use
- When no content is left, or the learner ends the tutorial.
## How it works
1. Creates the closing system message with `messagerendertype=end`. 2. Clears `sectionid` and `componentid`. 3. Sets the channel's `channelstatus` to `finished`.
## Inputs
- `channel`: The tutorial chat channel (from the TutorMessageContext) - `tutorialid`: The tutorial
## Configuration
Attributes set on this skill row:
- `contextbean`: `tutorMessageContext`
## Outputs
- The channel saved as finished
## Implementation
- Bean `adaptiveTutorialEndSkill`: `org.entermediadb.ai.skills.AdaptiveTutorialEndSkill` - Agent type: `remoteagent`
